ShARC, a conversational QA task , requires a system to answer user questions based on rules expressed in natural language text.
outputs: Responses in conversational QA including Yes/No answers, Irrelevant replies, or follow-up questions
The system generates either a Yes/No/Irrelevant answer or a follow-up question in a conversational setting.

quote: The following metrics are used in the evaluation of the ShARC task: 1. Micro and Macro Accuracy... 2. BLEU...
